name: Mitchell Howard
original_name: ミッチェル・ホワード
source:
“Everyone wants to be rich, but with money comes corruption. Aiming for the rank just below "rich" is the best of both worlds.”

A cadet in the Wings of Garuda.
This petit son of a merchant isn't really fit for knighthood, but his intelligence and worldly wisdom have helped him carve out his own unique space in the Wings. He makes a slight profit by selling prints of Crius on the side.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=mitchell]the official site[/url]]
